cand.title: 2026 Ci2i Symposium
cand.organizationName: UHN Collaborative Centre for Immunology to Immunotherapy / EPIC
cand.excerpt: In-person full-day scientific symposium at Delta Hotels Toronto, immediately following the Canadian Cancer Immunotherapy Consortium Annual Meeting, with national and international academic speakers, interdisciplinary networking, and a reception.
cand.selectionWhy: Prior blocked-promising candidate (no exact date/contact in thin ledger)

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Ksenia Meteleva: Ci2i Project Manager, acknowledged in UHN’s 2025 symposium report and named sponsorship contact in the 2025 prospectus (ksenia.meteleva@uhn.ca). Best operational/commercial routing candidate; her 2026 public symposium promotion supports continued involvement, but hotel procurement authority is not established. Dr. Tracy McGaha: Chair of the 2025 Ci2i Symposium Planning Committee; a relevant programme sponsor and referral/escalation contact, not a verified hotel buyer. Kim Hussey: UHN Conference Services Manager, a secondary institutional routing contact only; no edition-specific delivery mandate was established.
findings.futureEdition: None officially announced was located for December 2026–June 2028. The verified Ci2i activity date is October 23, 2026, not October 21–23: October 21–22 belongs to the separate CCIC meeting. Do not use registration-period dates as event dates. Annual wording supports recurrence, not a confirmed 2027 date, city or venue.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel capacities: a downtown scientific meeting is more aligned with city-hotel lodging than a resort retreat. Radisson Blu could pursue a future, separately scoped speaker/VIP or travelling-delegate allotment and small side meetings if Toronto recurs and sourcing permits. No room quantity is supportable. The 2025 actual in-person audience exceeded 250, above the supplied Admiral Ballroom theatre capacity of about 240, so a like-sized full plenary is not a defensible meeting-space pitch. The 157-room property should not be offered as exclusive housing for all attendees. Local UHN/U of T participation weakens any assumption that attendance converts to guestrooms. No catering or restaurant availability is assumed.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical 2026 venue: Delta Hotels Toronto, 75 Lower Simcoe Street, Toronto, Ontario, Canada, in downtown Toronto proper within the hotel’s downtown/MTCC territory. This is a competing hotel and a published event-venue selection, not evidence of a lodging allotment or a future venue contract. EPIC lists a full-day scientific programme and reception. No future venue commitment was located.
findings.historicalRotation: June 12, 2025: inaugural Ci2i Launch Symposium, MaRS Conference Centre / MaRS Discovery District, 101 College Street, Toronto. October 23, 2026: annual Ci2i Symposium, Delta Hotels Toronto, 75 Lower Simcoe Street, Toronto. This demonstrates a Toronto venue change between two editions, not destination rotation or a stable annual month.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The edition-specific joint meeting website states: “We are pleased to provide attendees with information on recommended hotels near the meeting venue.” It then states: “Please note that attendees are responsible for making their own reservations directly with the hotel unless otherwise indicated.” Thus the published pathway is attendee-direct reservations, not a verified housing bureau. Delta Hotels Toronto is the only hotel name verifiable in the retrieved text and is the meeting venue. A graphic follows the hotel-information text; its hotel names/details could not be verified. Consequently a complete recommended-hotel list remains unresolved. No named room block, contracted room quantity, booking code, cutoff, housing bureau or open hotel RFP was verified. Do not interpret recommendations as commitments or infer sourcing is open.
findings.organizationStructure: Ci2i is a UHN interdisciplinary research collaborative centre, not a verified independent membership association, corporate event agency, PCO or DMC. UHN is the institutional owner context. EPIC publishes the event listing; that alone does not establish event ownership or procurement authority. The registration site explicitly says CCIC and Ci2i are independent meetings held back-to-back. UHN Conference Services offers event management, but its generic services page does not establish appointment to this symposium.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Delta was the 2026 meeting venue and therefore an on-site convenience competitor; no exclusive lodging agreement or contracted block was verified. The 2025 report records more than 250 in-person attendees and over 120 virtual participants; these are historical attendance figures, not 2026 attendance or hotel demand. No hotel sellout, denied rooms, overflow allocation or unmet accommodation demand was verified. A public organizer promotion describes unmet 2025 in-person attendance interest, but this does not establish hotel overflow.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Remove the unsupported SALES_READY treatment and retain as historical relationship development, subject to ORS qualification. Contact Ksenia Meteleva at the published institutional address, referencing the 2026 Delta meeting, to ask whether a 2027/2028 edition is approved, who handles accommodation, and when hotel decisions occur. Use ci2isymposium@gmail.com as the edition-published routing mailbox. Seek Tracy McGaha’s referral if needed. Ask for actual non-local delegates, speaker room requirements, prior pickup and any Delta restrictions before proposing an allotment. Do not quote a room forecast or pitch relocation of the entire symposium.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The October 23, 2026 edition is past as of November 15, 2026 and outside the requested horizon. It has no current-edition booking opportunity. Historical attendee-direct hotel reservations are not evidence that a future edition is accessible or currently sourcing.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional inference: the 2025 launch and explicitly annual 2026 symposium justify relationship development for another cycle. They do not establish an announced edition, Toronto return, open inventory or a competitive venue tender. If a future Toronto edition is confirmed, seek a small speaker/delegate lodging role or inclusion in recommendations before making a full-meeting proposal. Continuing co-location with CCIC could increase length of stay, but future co-location and resulting room nights are unverified.
